# HarnessDock v0.1.6-alpha.1

HarnessDock `v0.1.6-alpha.1` realigns the desktop client with the newly published DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1` release and republishes the complete candidate artifact set from one exact source revision.

This is a **replaceable prerelease**. Stable `v0.1.5` remains immutable. A reissue is allowed only after the exact new main SHA passes the source, mobile, packaged-startup, candidate-artifact, checksum, and Runtime identity gates.

## Runtime alignment

- Pinned upstream source: `dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1`
- Pinned upstream commit: `0a15e36e7f82b6ed45af6fa9759f29b40dcd965d`
- Product base version: `0.1.6`, matching the pinned dsh base SemVer.
- Candidate identity: `v0.1.6-alpha.1`.
- The npm provenance record includes the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.6-alpha.1` tarball and integrity value.
- Desktop candidates build and seal the official upstream source closure as the local Runtime.
- Android and iOS remain Remote Gateway clients and do not embed a desktop Runtime.

## Release contract

- Runtime lifecycle diagnostics and export use the versioned `DiagnosticReportV2` model.
- The bridge, startup, shutdown, recovery, and Runtime provenance paths remain guarded by the existing Host Protocol and release-contract checks.
- The candidate keeps the full artifact, checksum, sealed Runtime identity, and same-SHA verification policy.
- Stable `v0.1.5` is not moved, overwritten, or reused.

## Verification

The release is published only after the repository checks and CI gates pass, including Rust/Tauri checks, parity and contract tests, mobile checks, candidate packaging, Windows startup/rescue coverage, Runtime identity verification, and `SHA256SUMS` verification.
